summary: Iteration 6 (Templates, per-room Estimator, Alerts UI) — ALL new features verified. Backend: 9/9 pytest passing (GET /api/templates returns 4 templates kitnet_30/edicula_25/casa_60/casa_90 each with correctly shaped rooms; POST /api/estimate returns per_room with area/cost/cost_per_m2/share where wet rooms Banheiro & Cozinha have 1.35x multiplier confirmed higher R$/m² than Sala/Quarto; alerts CRUD create→list→delete all pass; per-room shares sum to 100% and costs sum ≈ estimated_total within rounding). Frontend at 390x844: Home shows two new tiles (home-tile-templates, home-tile-alerts) and Hero secondary CTA (home-cta-templates 'ou use um modelo'). Templates screen lists all 4 cards with room-preview chips (Sala/Quarto, Cozinha, Banheiro + '+N' for larger houses). Tapping template-kitnet_30 creates a project via POST /api/projects and lands on Plan2D with 3 rooms (Sala/Quarto 5×4, Cozinha 3×2, Banheiro 2×2). Estimator segment 'LISTA COMPLETA' (default) shows materials; toggling POR AMBIENTE shows per-room breakdown with a cost bar (Sala/Quarto R$ 2,301.49 · 115.07/m² · 59.7%, Cozinha R$ 932.10 · 155.35/m² · 24.2%, Banheiro R$ 621.40 · 155.35/m² · 16.1%). Alerts screen: empty state → create via suggestion chip + price → alert appears in list → alert-view-{id} navigates to Offers with the query pre-filled ('Cimento 50kg' shown in the search input) → alert-remove-{id} deletes the alert. No React Native red screens. No deprecated packages detected. Pre-existing Reanimated shared-value read-during-render warnings still present from Plan2D (non-blocking; not new to this iteration).

issues: The bottom row (home-tile-alerts) sits close to the 83px tab bar on a 390x844 viewport — it's still reachable via scroll but on shorter devices the tile can be visually cropped. Consider adding bottom padding equal to tab-bar height inside Screen's ScrollView content.

action_items: Optional: Add bottom padding (or a spacer equal to tab-bar height ~90px) to the Home Screen's ScrollView content so the last row (home-tile-alerts) never sits under the tab bar on shorter phones.
Optional: Consider adding a testID to the Home hero secondary CTA container or reusing the existing home-cta-templates label to also match 'ou use um modelo' for easier automation (already works).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py room_multiplier logic is well-scoped and unit-covered by test_phase3_api.py (banheiro/cozinha 1.35, área/serviço 1.15, varanda/quintal 0.75). Per-room shares sum to 100% and per-room costs sum to estimated_total within 1 BRL rounding drift.
GET /api/templates is public (no auth) and returns a static, safe catalog — appropriate.

Templates.tsx and Alerts.tsx are small (<200 lines), use StyleSheet.create, wrap all text in <Text>, and use testIDs on every interactive element (template-{id}, alert-{id}, alert-view-{id}, alert-remove-{id}, suggest-{name}, alert-query, alert-price, alert-save).
Estimator segment toggle (view-materials/view-rooms) uses proper controlled state and forwards testIDs to each per-room row (room-cost-{name}).
Home hero card correctly wires 'ou use um modelo' to setTab('templates').
seed_data_creation: Two test alerts ('Cimento 50kg' at R$ 35.50 and R$ 39.90) were created for the demo user during pytest and UI runs; both were removed by the cleanup step at the end of the Playwright run and by DELETE in test_delete_alert.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use demo@constroifacil.app / senha123 at https://build-discount-hub.preview.emergentagent.com. New public endpoint GET /api/templates (no auth). POST /api/estimate now returns per_room:[{name,area,cost,cost_per_m2,share}]. Home has new tiles home-tile-templates and home-tile-alerts; Hero has secondary CTA home-cta-templates. Templates screen testID=templates-screen and each card testID=template-{id}. Alerts screen testID=alerts-screen; form fields alert-query & alert-price; save alert-save; per-alert testIDs alert-{id}, alert-view-{id}, alert-remove-{id}. Estimator toggle testIDs view-materials/view-rooms; each per-room row testID=room-cost-{name}. Home ScrollView needs scrolling to reveal home-tile-alerts on 390x844 (last row is partly under 83px tab bar).
rca_of_issue: Not applicable — no bugs surfaced. Only a minor UX observation: bottom tile (home-tile-alerts) can be partially hidden behind the fixed 83px tab bar because the Home ScrollView's contentContainer does not add extra bottom padding for the tab-bar. Mitigation: add paddingBottom ~ 100 to the Screen/ScrollView contentContainerStyle used by Home.
